name: devops
description: Skills and agents for CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure

rules.name: coding-standards
rules.description: Keep functions and components small, readable, and easy to reason about.

rules.name: docs-parity
rules.description: Keep documentation in sync with every user-facing change.

rules.name: early-returns
rules.description: Prefer early returns and guard clauses over nested conditionals.

rules.name: git-move
rules.description: Use git mv for tracked files to preserve history.

rules.name: git-workflow
rules.description: Branch protection, branch naming, and PR workflow rules — no direct pushes to main, branches must follow type/description convention, PRs must be rebased on top of origin/main before raising.

rules.name: mermaid-diagrams
rules.description: Use Mermaid diagrams instead of ASCII art.

rules.name: never-read-env
rules.description: Never read .env files directly in code.

rules.name: pre-commit-checks
rules.description: Run formatter, linter, and build checks before every commit.

skills.name: docs-upkeep
skills.description: Keep canonical documentation aligned with implementation and workflow changes in the same task.

skills.name: workspace-hygiene
skills.description: On-demand workspace audit — review change scope, clean temp artifacts, verify commit focus.

agents.name: docs-maintainer
agents.description: Keeps documentation aligned with code and workflow changes.
